schema.title: Manifest.json Schema
schema.description: qooxdoo's Manifest files serve to provide meta information for a library in a structured way. Their syntax is in JSON. They have a more informational part (keyed info), which is more interesting for human readers, a technical part (named provides) that is used in the processing of generator configurations, and a part named externalResources to include CSS and Javascript files.

$schema.description: the json schema of the version of Manifest.json

qooxdoo-versions.description: (deprecated) An array of qooxdoo versions that this library is compatible with. This property is deprecated and will be removed in version 7.

sourceViewUri.description: URL to view the library's class code online. This URL will be used in generated API documentation. It has a special syntax and allows for placeholders (e.g. for the class name and the source line number).

namespace.description: Library namespace (i.e. the namespace elements all class names in this library are prefixed with, e.g. foo for a main application class with name foo.Application).

encoding.description: File encoding of source code files

class.description: Path to the library's class code relative to the Manifest.json file, up to but not including the root namespace folder

resource.description: Path to the library's resources relative to the Manifest.json file, up to but not including the root namespace folder

translation.description: Path to the library's translation files relative to the Manifest.json file

mapping.description: Path to a json font map relative to the resource folder

comparisonString.description: String to test of font is loaded.

items.description: Path to the webfont file relative to the resource folder

requires.description: a list of of needed libraries and contribs. the keys `qooxdoo-sdk` and `qooxdoo-compiler` are also recognized to descript the respective versions of these components

externalResources.description: Static Javascript and CSS files that shall be always included without further processing by qooxdoo. All paths are relative to the resource folder stated in the 'provides' section.

setup.description: Setup Section - used in Qooxdoo SDK Manifest.json ... do we need this still?

description:
The MyApp Library (version 1.2.3) is a sample qooxdoo library that supplies a set of ready‑to‑use widgets and utility classes for building web applications with the Qooxdoo framework. Its purpose is summarized as “A sample qooxdoo library for demonstration,” and it is described as providing “sample widgets and utilities for building web applications using the Qooxdoo framework.” The project is tagged with the keywords qooxdoo, sample and widgets, and its homepage is hosted at https://github.com/example/myapp under an MIT licence. The two contributors are Jane Doe <jane.doe@example.com> (GitHub user janedoe) and John Smith <john.smith@example.com>. Source code can be viewed online via https://github.com/example/myapp/blob/main/%path%#L%line%, and the manifest follows the schema defined at https://qooxdoo.org/schema/Manifest-1-0-0.json.

Technically, the library lives under the namespace myapp. All source files are UTF‑8 encoded, with class files located in source/class, resources in source/resource, and translation files in source/translation. It ships a webfont named OpenSans with a default size of 14 pt; the font mapping is defined in fonts/opensans.json, the test string is “The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog,” and the actual font files are fonts/opensans-regular.woff2 and fonts/opensans-bold.woff2. The library depends on @qooxdoo/framework (^7.0.0), @qooxdoo/compiler (^7.0.0) and also requires the contrib package qx-contrib-foo (^1.5). Finally, it bundles static external resources that should always be included: the CSS files css/theme.css and css/custom.scss, together with the JavaScript file js/extra.js.
